text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa gave it her absolute all. 
But she fell short of the "Silence 
Fugitive," Silence Suzuka... and was 
defeated.

Having pushed far past her limits, she 
loses consciousness and collapses.

El Condor Pasa painfully realized that her 
current self stood no chance against 
overseas Umamusume who were likely even 
more formidable than Silence Suzuka.

She was forced to give up on "winning the 
Japan Cup during her Classic year." Having 
abandoned her dream, she sank to the 
depths of despair.
